# LJ Web Management

> LJ Web Management teaches practical, self-paced tech and AI courses covering artificial intelligence, web and app development, automation, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and career skills.

LJ Web Management is based in Lockport, Illinois. The company sells digital courses priced between $12 and $49 each, as one-time payments with no subscription. Courses are self-paced, delivered by email after purchase, and cover topics from AI fundamentals and prompt engineering to web development, no-code automation, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and career skills for the AI era.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/): Overview of the course catalog and what LJ Web Management teaches.
- [Courses](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/courses): Full catalog of 62 self-paced courses, searchable and filterable by category and level.
- [How It Works](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/how-it-works): Explains the process from browsing a course to purchase to receiving access by email.
- [Book an Appointment](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/appointment): Book a time to enroll in a course and get a payment link.
- [FAQ](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/faq): Answers on pricing, payment, refunds, and access.
- [Contact Us](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/contactus): General contact information and inquiry form.
